🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation vs concentrated weakness in Technology and large-cap Financials; Leadership concentrated (3/5 Real Estate) — hence mixed signals, reduce conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Real Estate leads: AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND, EQIX (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +18.73%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: AEP (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND, EXC (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND. Communication showing strength: TMUS (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +15.18%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology weak: AAPL (1W: -3.91% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: JPM (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -0.69%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: -8.07% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND. Energy mixed but softer on the week: XOM (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +13.97%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: +13.26% | 1M: -3.04%) RECOVERY, AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +15.18%) ABOVE TREND, EQIX (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +18.73%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +10.57% | 1M: +1.60%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Real Estate).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ACN (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -23.59%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.19% | 1M: -12.76%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -1.27%) BELOW TREND, C (1W: -8.07% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -4.43%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in large-cap Tech and Financial names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: EL (1W: +13.26% | 1M: -3.04%) RECOVERY, AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +15.18%) ABOVE TREND; watch EL and UNH (1W: +4.86% | 1M: -14.71%) RECOVERY for short-term reversals — EL shows 1W/1M divergence (MAJOR divergence signal).

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is under pressure: sector 1W: -4.07% | 1M: -8.16% with heavy names below trend. AAPL (1W: -3.91% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND — watch for continued dispersion and trend confirmation; sector is a source of market conflict.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials lag on the week: sector 1W: -3.81% | 1M: -2.49%; large banks under pressure. JPM (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -0.69%) BELOW TREND, AIG (1W: +6.01% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND — mixed internals, tail risk from earnings/news remains.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is steady but mixed: sector 1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.87%. JNJ (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +4.86% | 1M: -14.71%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +0.47%) CORRECTION — defensive names showing resilience despite headline noise.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Real Estate and Utilities given leadership and confirmed ABOVE TREND names (AMT, EQIX, AEP) and reduce exposure to large-cap Technology and stressed banks showing BELOW TREND price action (MSFT, C, ACN). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; tactically favor cyclical/real-asset strength while watching for tech/financial follow-through.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND, EQIX (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +18.73%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +8.64% | 1M: +12.55%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ACN (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -23.59%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -13.33% | 1M: -31.63%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -9.11%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Real Estate (strong 1W gains, breadth support), Utilities (earnings-driven strength). BEARISH: Technology (continued selling pressure), Financials (banks showing stress on week).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND for a decisive reclaim of 1M trend to validate recovery; AAPL (1W: -3.91% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION — monitor 1W follow-through for trend resolution; AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND — watch for continuation above recent highs as confirmation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AEP (+80): AEP (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by earnings beat and price action. EQIX (+60): EQIX (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +18.73%) ABOVE TREND — AI-driven results and dividend thesis confirmed. NVDA (+60): NVDA (1W: -2.67% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND — bullish news on AI hub but price is diverging (distribution signal).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (-85): JNJ (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +10.82%) ABOVE TREND — negative legal headline but price is holding (divergence). AMT (-60): AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND — capital-raise headlines bearish but price shows strength (divergence). C (-45): C (1W: -8.07% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — bearish sentiment confirmed by steep weekly underperformance.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; style mixed / no clear leadership, favor cyclical/real-asset exposure over headline-driven Tech. AMT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +6.36%) ABOVE TREND, EQIX (1W: +10.99% | 1M: +18.73%) ABOVE TREND, AEP (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: Tech and select banks remain BELOW TREND while several names (JNJ, AMT, NVDA) show sentiment/price divergence — watch for trend confirmation.
